draft.emotion: cautionary but warm, acknowledging the power and the comfort of the flames
notes: Used for everyday fires (fireplace, campfire, stove) as well as destructive ones; 'η πυρκαγιά' specifically means a large, uncontrolled blaze or wildfire.
In cooking, 'στη φωτιά' means 'on the stove / burner' (e.g., 'Βάλε το φαγητό στη φωτιά' — Put the food on the stove).
